author: GoPro
description:
A legendary line has just been written in the history of alpinism and BASE jumping. A team of friends, GoPro Awards recipient Konstantin Jäämurd, Boris Egorov, and Vladimir Murzaev, have become the first ever to climb and wingsuit from Cerro Chaltén (Monte Fitz Roy), one of the most iconic and demanding peaks in the world for for alpine mountaineering.

📍 Location: Patagonia, Argentina
⛰️ Elevation: 3,405 m / 11,171 ft

After a committing multi-day rock climb up the towering granite walls of Fitz Roy, the team launched into the Patagonian sky. This is their raw POV, shot on our 360 camera, GoPro MAX2.
